test_code:
import pytest
from main import get_transaction_range

test_cases = [
    ([1200, 4500, 900, 3300], (900, 4500)),
    ([5000, 1000, 3000, 4000], (1000, 5000)),
]

validation_cases = [
    pytest.param([99, 100, 101], (99, 101), marks=pytest.mark.validate),
    pytest.param([2500], (2500, 2500), marks=pytest.mark.validate),
]

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input1", "expected_output"), test_cases + validation_cases
)
def test_get_transaction_range(input1, expected_output):
    print("\n---------------------------------")
    print(f"Inputs: {input1}")
    result = get_transaction_range(input1)
    print(f"Expected: {expected_output}")
    print(f"Actual:   {result}")
    assert result == expected_output
solution_code:
def get_transaction_range(amounts: list[int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return min(amounts), max(amounts)
